meta.note: v1.3 Economics worker Role pack (RFC-WORKFLOW-V1)：role = responsibility + authority + inputs/outputs + capability_scope + escalation；科研方法由 study.selected_capabilities -> registry -> resolver 决定。economics_director 是 domain-level 科学控制器（契约=study_design），不在 roles.json；visualize 已降为 future presentation capability（本阶段不建）。

roles.name: 文献检索
roles.description: Multi-source retrieval, dedupe, screening, source verification
responsibility: run systematic literature search across specified sources
dedupe and screen by title/abstract
verify citation metadata (DOI/author/journal/year)
produce a structured search log and record sources
escalation_rules: If a source cannot be legally retrieved, record it and continue; never fabricate citations.

roles.name: 文献综述
roles.description: Synthesize a structured, cited literature review from the search log
responsibility: synthesize the search log into a structured review (state, debates, gaps)
ground claims in real, verified citations
tag evidence grading for causal/mechanism claims
escalation_rules: Never invent a citation; a claim without a verifiable source must be flagged.

roles.name: 数据处理
roles.description: Acquire, clean, validate and document the analysis dataset
responsibility: build the analysis dataset from the agreed sources
clean, validate, and construct variables per the approved data design

emit structured machine-readable artifacts (data_manifest / variable_dictionary / sample_flow / descriptive_facts / decision_log) as the single source of truth; data_summary is only the presentation layer
escalation_rules: Unit of analysis, treatment definition and sample exclusion must be escalated before construction.

roles.name: 实证/显著性
roles.description: Execute the approved empirical design and produce structured outputs
responsibility: execute the approved empirical design
run diagnostics required by the selected capabilities
produce structured empirical outputs (model_registry, estimates, diagnostics)
report deviations from the design
maintain decision and provenance records; replication_stamp is produced by a deterministic builder (core/build_replication_stamp.mjs) from model_registry/estimates/diagnostics — never hand-written
escalation_rules: Identification/treatment/clustering/sample decisions must be escalated; estimator changes are material and must be escalated.

roles.name: 写作
roles.description: Assemble a structured manuscript from upstream outputs
responsibility: assemble the manuscript per the chosen output profile
keep every claim traceable to upstream outputs (evidence ledger)
do not invent results or citations
escalation_rules: Facts must come from upstream outputs; unsupported claims must be flagged, never invented.

roles.name: 审查/审稿
responsibility: review the manuscript with an adversarial reviewer lens
run the reproducibility / format check against the upstream artifacts
output a structured review report and replicability check
escalation_rules: Flag any mismatch between a claim and the underlying evidence; do not rubber-stamp.
